name: OfficeAdmin Site

public_commands.name: watch-modules
public_commands.description: Long-running fswatch wrapper that regenerates the catalog on any module change. Normally invoked by launchd.

notes: Public landing + auto-populated documentation site at landing.officeadmin.io (moved off the officeadmin.io apex 2026-06-11; the apex now serves the Books app on Vercel, with /landingpage redirecting here). Catalog of modules is generated live from ~/.aiva/modules/ on every file change, but you still need to git push to deploy.
